description: Return the debtor's counsel of record: each attorney's name, firm, address, phone, and email. Trustees are not included. Identifies the case by simpleName. Pass simple_name or a case number (with court when the number is reused). When no counsel is stored, counsel is an empty list. Single Case plan: monitored cases only. Subscribers only.

case_number.description: 7-digit short case number alternative to simple_name.

court.description: Court name as returned in the court field, for example "Delaware" or "Texas Southern".

court_state.description: 2-letter state. Matches every district in that state.

name: get_debtor_counsel_tool
